text:
## 1. Launch email
Hi [First name],

Picture a Tuesday. The quote is sent, the job is booked, and from there the conversation happens somewhere else. Your phone, your inbox, a voicemail, a text. By Friday you are piecing together who said what.

Here is the fix. Meet **[Job Thread]**: starting [date], Acme Dispatch keeps the whole conversation on the job card.

- **Texts from the job.** Text any customer [from your own business number]. Every text is saved on the job card, and [replies land next to it].
- **Calls and emails from the job.** Call from your phone. Send the quote and the invoice by email. All of it is saved on the job card automatically.
- **Follow-ups that don't slip.** Each unanswered quote [becomes a dated reminder on the job], drafted from your notes. Edit it, send it, or skip it. Nothing goes to a customer without your tap.
- **One timeline.** The timeline you already have, quotes, visits and invoices, now shows every text, call and email next to them, dated.
- [Crew accounts only] **Crew view with the whole story.** Techs open a job and [see the texts that came with it].

**Getting started.** Every customer you've quoted in Acme Dispatch is already here.
1. Connect your email once. Email works right away.
2. Choose a local number and ring customers right away, or [move your office line across].
3. Texting from your own number begins after the one-time US registration for business lines, [Acme files it for you].

Already on LedgerLite? Keep it for your books. Bring any invoice in with one click, as you do today.

**You stay in control:**
- [Texts go only to customers who've said yes, and a STOP reply ends texting to them automatically.]
- [Call recording is off unless you turn it on.]
- [Texting comes with Pro and Crew.] Calls and texts: [N minutes and N texts a month included, then $X a minute and $Y a text].
- [Your customers and their messages are never used for marketing, and never sold.]
- [Your customers, messages and recordings export any time; nothing is held back if you leave.]

**Where to find it:** open any customer → Job → **[Job Thread]**.

See one customer go from first call to paid invoice, live: **Wednesday, [date], 11 AM PT / 1 PM CT / 2 PM ET**.

**[Save My Seat]**

Questions? Give us a call at 555-0100 - [a person picks up].
